dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the wide mid-section toward a pointed posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey baseline with subtle blue-violet undertones.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-contrast, sparse mottling visible as faint grey clusters across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey skin and slightly darker mottled areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) located on the anterior dorsal surface.
